name: Lecture clip extract (H1452) — ffmpeg + VK + Laravel callback

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Respond immediately (onReceived): the ffmpeg→VK→callback chain runs async and reports back via the Laravel callback node. Laravel's DispatchLectureClipExtractionJob calls this webhook with Http::timeout(15) and tries=3 — with responseMode=lastNode it would ALWAYS time out (ffmpeg node alone allows 600s), retry 3×, and cut+upload every clip to VK three times.
